basic_info.description: Welcome Home Mrs. Madrigral. Built in 1953 which has original design is a wonderful 4 unit building with 6 beds and 5 baths total - 1 Studio, 2 one bedroom units and a separate house which is 3 bedrooms, two full baths plus 2 car garage. The magical garden separates the two buildings. The studio is gutted to the studs awaiting someone with their own renovations. The house is designed on two levels, the top floor features a large living room with fireplace, a large eat-in kitchen and two bedrooms and one full bath with a bedroom suite down. Parking garage is at rear of property on Ames St. The studio and the house is vacant, ideal for an owner user with income from the two rented units. Immediate proximity to 16th St transit station, Valencia St thriving corridor, shopping & dining, Bi-Rite. This is a solid investment with stable rental income. Whether you're looking for a great income-generating property or a place to live while renting out the other 3 units, this quadruplex checks all the boxes. Don't miss out on this rare find in a prime location!
